description: W.M. Princess Fernando and Others v. K.A. Gunasekera Appuhamy and Another W.M. Princess Fernando and Others v. K.A. Gunasekera Appuhamy and Another View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: W.M. Princess Fernando and Others v. K.A. Gunasekera Appuhamy and Another W.M. Princess Fernando and Others v. K.A. Gunasekera Appuhamy and Another View More
keywords: The Appellants challenged the partition judgment and sought to introduce additional title deeds as fresh evidence. Held - Appellants had failed to establish that the deeds could not have been obtained with reasonable diligence for use at the trial. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
